#{roleId}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM auth_subject_grant g INNER JOIN auth_capability c ON g.capability_id = c.capability_id INNER JOIN auth_scope s ON g.scope_id = s.scope_id WHERE g.subject_type = 'app' AND g.subject_id = CAST(#{appId} AS CHAR) AND g.status = '1' AND g.deleted = '0' AND c.enabled = '1' AND c.deleted = '0' AND s.enabled = '1' AND s.deleted = '0' AND (c.resource_type IS NULL OR c.resource_type = '' OR c.resource_type = '*' OR c.resource_type = #{resourceType}) AND ( ( ( c.resource_pattern IS NULL OR c.resource_pattern = '' OR c.resource_pattern = '*' OR #{resourceId} LIKE REPLACE(c.resource_pattern, '*', '%') ) AND ( s.actions IS NULL OR s.actions = '' OR s.actions = '*' OR FIND_IN_SET(#{action}, s.actions) > 0 OR #{action} LIKE REPLACE(s.actions, '*', '%') ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_scope_resource sr INNER JOIN auth_open_api_resource r ON sr.resource_id = r.resource_id WHERE sr.scope_id = s.scope_id AND r.deleted = '0' AND r.status = '1' AND (r.tenant_id IS NULL OR r.tenant_id = '' OR r.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND (r.http_method = '*' OR r.http_method = 'ALL' OR #{action} LIKE CONCAT(r.http_method, ':%')) AND #{resourceId} LIKE REPLACE(r.path_pattern, '*', '%') ) )
AND (g.tenant_id IS NULL OR g.tenant_id = '' OR g.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND (c.tenant_id IS NULL OR c.tenant_id = '' OR c.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND (s.tenant_id IS NULL OR s.tenant_id = '' OR s.tenant_id = #{tenantId})

SELECT q.* FROM auth_quota_policy q WHERE q.subject_type = #{subjectType} AND q.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND q.enabled = '1' AND q.deleted = '0' AND ( (q.capability_id IS NULL AND q.scope_id IS NULL) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_subject_grant g INNER JOIN auth_capability c ON g.capability_id = c.capability_id INNER JOIN auth_scope s ON g.scope_id = s.scope_id WHERE g.subject_type = q.subject_type AND g.subject_id = q.subject_id AND g.status = '1' AND g.deleted = '0' AND c.enabled = '1' AND c.deleted = '0' AND s.enabled = '1' AND s.deleted = '0' AND (q.capability_id IS NULL OR q.capability_id = g.capability_id) AND (q.scope_id IS NULL OR q.scope_id = g.scope_id) AND (c.resource_type IS NULL OR c.resource_type = '' OR c.resource_type = '*' OR c.resource_type = #{resourceType}) AND ( ( ( c.resource_pattern IS NULL OR c.resource_pattern = '' OR c.resource_pattern = '*' OR #{resourceId} LIKE REPLACE(c.resource_pattern, '*', '%') ) AND ( s.actions IS NULL OR s.actions = '' OR s.actions = '*' OR FIND_IN_SET(#{action}, s.actions) > 0 OR #{action} LIKE REPLACE(s.actions, '*', '%') ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_scope_resource sr INNER JOIN auth_open_api_resource r ON sr.resource_id = r.resource_id WHERE sr.scope_id = s.scope_id AND r.deleted = '0' AND r.status = '1' AND (r.http_method = '*' OR r.http_method = 'ALL' OR #{action} LIKE CONCAT(r.http_method, ':%')) AND #{resourceId} LIKE REPLACE(r.path_pattern, '*', '%') ) ) ) )
AND (q.tenant_id IS NULL OR q.tenant_id = '' OR q.tenant_id = #{tenantId})
ORDER BY q.quota_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT r.* FROM auth_subject_grant g INNER JOIN auth_scope_resource sr ON g.scope_id = sr.scope_id INNER JOIN auth_open_api_resource r ON sr.resource_id = r.resource_id INNER JOIN auth_capability c ON g.capability_id = c.capability_id INNER JOIN auth_scope s ON g.scope_id = s.scope_id WHERE g.subject_type = 'app' AND g.subject_id = CAST(#{appId} AS CHAR) AND g.status = '1' AND g.deleted = '0' AND r.status = '1' AND r.deleted = '0' AND c.enabled = '1' AND c.deleted = '0' AND s.enabled = '1' AND s.deleted = '0'
AND (g.tenant_id IS NULL OR g.tenant_id = '' OR g.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND (r.tenant_id IS NULL OR r.tenant_id = '' OR r.tenant_id = #{tenantId})
ORDER BY r.resource_code ASC, r.resource_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT s.scope_code FROM auth_subject_grant g INNER JOIN auth_scope s ON g.scope_id = s.scope_id INNER JOIN auth_capability c ON g.capability_id = c.capability_id WHERE g.subject_type = 'app' AND g.subject_id = CAST(#{appId} AS CHAR) AND g.status = '1' AND g.deleted = '0' AND s.enabled = '1' AND s.deleted = '0' AND c.enabled = '1' AND c.deleted = '0'
AND (g.tenant_id IS NULL OR g.tenant_id = '' OR g.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND (s.tenant_id IS NULL OR s.tenant_id = '' OR s.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND (c.tenant_id IS NULL OR c.tenant_id = '' OR c.tenant_id = #{tenantId})
ORDER BY s.scope_code ASC
